Workflow.Name: YE - Maintenance: Flag Affected Bookings
Workflow.Description: Case cycle: when a case takes a facility out of service (or its expected return date changes), upcoming bookings on that facility during the closure are marked Affected by Maintenance, for the coordinator to reschedule or cancel.
